{{Short description|Beninese academic}}
{{Orphan|date=September 2025}}
{{Infobox person | name = Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï | image = Photo Prof Glèlè Kakaï.jpg | image_size = | caption = | birth_date = February 28, 1973 | birth_place = [[Cotonou]], [[Benin]] | occupation = Professor of Biostatistics and Forest Estimations | known_for = Forest modeling, Biomathematics, Applied statistics | education = Engineer in Agronomy (2000)<br/>MSc in Biometry (2001)<br/>PhD in Biometry (2005) | alma_mater = [[Gembloux Agro-Bio Tech]] (Belgium) | employer = [[University of Abomey-Calavi]] | title = Full Professor, Head of Laboratory of Biomathematics and Forest Estimations }}

'''Romain Glèlè Kakaï''', whose full name is '''Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï Agbidinoukoun''', born on February 28, 1973, in [[Cotonou]],<ref>{{Cite web |language=en |author=itto.int |title=INTERNATIONAL TROPICAL TIMBER ORGANIZATION |url=https://www.itto.int/files/itto_project_db_input/3027/project/E-PD-678-12-R1-M-Benin-Project-Document.pdf?v=1709238985 |access-date=}}</ref> is a Beninese academic specializing in biomathematics and forest estimations and a member of the [[African Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":7">{{Cite web |last=Banouto |date=2025-04-26 |title=Académie africaine des sciences: le Béninois Romain Glèlè Kakaï fait son entrée |url=https://www.banouto.bj/societe/article/20250426-academie-africaine-des-sciences-le-beninois-romain-glele-kakai-fait-son-entree |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=banouto.bj |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Adjimehossou |first=Fulbert |date=2022-11-11 |title=Classement 2023 de l'Alper-Doger Scientific : Le Bénin 23e en Afrique |url=https://lanation.bj/actualites/classement-2023-de-lalper-doger-scientific-le-benin-23e-en-afrique |access-date=2025-06-30 |website=lanation.bj |language=fr}}</ref>

A lecturer at the Faculty of Agronomic Sciences of the [[University of Abomey-Calavi]] in Benin, he has distinguished himself through his research work and prolific scientific production and is ranked 2nd in the top 100 scientists of Benin according to the [[:it:AD Scientific Index|AD Scientific Index]].<ref name="Excellence et leadership scientifiques : le professeur Romain Glèlè Kakaï fait son entrée dans l'AAS -">{{Cite web |last=Jupiter |date=2025-04-26 |title=Excellence et leadership scientifiques : le professeur Romain Glèlè Kakaï fait son entrée dans l'AAS - |url=https://jupiterinfo.bj/2025/04/26/excellence-et-leadership-scientifiques-le-professeur-romain-glele-kakai-fait-son-entree-dans-laas/ |access-date=2025-06-27 |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite web |last=YAI |first=Isac |date=2025-04-29 |title=Académie Africaine des Sciences : Professeur Romain Glèlè Kakaï, fierté béninoise |url=https://fraternite.bj/academie-africaine-des-sciences-professeur-romain-glele-kakai-fierte-beninoise/ |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=Fraternité |language=fr-FR}}</ref>

== Biography ==

=== Origins and studies ===

Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï graduated top of his class at every stage of his academic training. He obtained a degree in General Agronomy in 1998, then a degree in Forest Agronomic Engineering in 2000 at the [[University of Abomey-Calavi]]. He continued his studies in Belgium at [[Gembloux Agro-Bio Tech]] of the [[University of Liège]] (formerly known as the University Faculty of Agricultural Sciences of Gembloux), where he earned a postgraduate diploma in applied statistics and computer science and a PhD in biometrics in 2005.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |language=en-US |title=Romain Lucas Glele Kakaï |url=https://globalyoungacademy.net/romain-lucas/ |website=Global Young Academy |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |language=en |first=The World Academy of |last=Sciences (TWAS) |title=Glele Kakai, Romain Lucas {{!}} TWAS |url=https://twas.org/directory/glele-kakai-romain-lucas |website=twas.org |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |language=fr-FR |title=L'Invité du Matin – 25 Janvier 2024 – Prof. ROMAIN GLELE KAKAÏ {{!}} BIP Radio |url=https://bipradio.com/podcast/linvite-du-matin-25-janvier-2024-prof-dr-romain-glele-kakai/ |website=BIP radio, Bénin Info Première |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref>

== Career and research domains ==

A Full Professor of [[Biostatistics]] at the Faculty of Agronomic Sciences of the [[University of Abomey-Calavi]], he heads the Laboratory of Biomathematics and Forest Estimations (LABEF) at this university, and coordinates master’s and doctoral programs in biostatistics, taught in English, which have attracted students from 23 African countries. He also chaired the Scientific Council of Agronomic Sciences of his university from 2016 to 2024, and was the first president of the Scientific Council of the National Institute of Agricultural Research of Benin (INRAB) from 2017 to 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |language=fr |last= |title=Institut National des Recherches Agricoles du Bénin |url=https://www.inrab.bj/ |website=www.inrab.bj |access-date=2025-06-30}}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |language=fr |title=Le Prof. Romain Glèlè Kakaï a séjourné à Fribourg |url=https://hrh.semca-uac.org/fr/article/le-prof-romain-glele-kakai-sejourne-fribourg |website=Hrh-Semca |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref>

An expert in mathematical modeling of living systems, his research is diverse and includes biomathematics, data science, and forest estimation. He has developed and popularized in Africa the practical applications of advanced statistical and mathematical methods in the life sciences through teaching, research, and scientific publications.<ref>{{Cite web |language=fr |last=Banouto |title=Académie africaine des sciences: le Béninois Romain Glèlè Kakaï fait son entrée |url=https://www.banouto.bj/societe/article/20250426-academie-africaine-des-sciences-le-beninois-romain-glele-kakai-fait-son-entree |website=banouto.bj |date=2025-04-26 |access-date=2025-06-30}}</ref>

His current research focuses on linear and nonlinear mixed-effects models, nonlinear dynamical systems, ecology, and the restoration of mangrove ecosystems.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï |url=https://sciprofiles.com/profile/1433543 |website=sciprofiles.com |access-date=2025-06-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250504105112/https://sciprofiles.com/profile/1433543 |archive-date=2025-05-04|publisher=Laboratory of Biomathematics and Forest Estimations, University of Abomey-Calavi}}</ref>

== Laboratory ==

The Laboratory of Biomathematics and Forest Estimations (LABEF), which he leads, aims to analyze the applicability of mathematical tools in the life sciences and to understand the interactions between ecological processes,<ref>{{Cite web |language=en |title=Laboratoire de Biomathématiques et d'Estimations Forestières Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) |url=https://brandfetch.com/ |website=Brandfetch |access-date=2025-06-28}}</ref> human health, anthropogenic factors, and the structure of terrestrial ecosystems, with a clear link to management and policy.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Romain Lucas Glele Kakai - Understanding Ecology Threats Assessment and Conservation of Afzelia africana in Benin - The Rufford Foundation |url=https://www.rufford.org/projects/romain-lucas-glele-kakai/understanding-ecology-threats-assessment-and-conservation-of-afzelia-africana-in-benin/ |website=www.rufford.org |access-date=2025-06-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |language=fr-FR |title=Prof. Dr. Ir. Romain Lucas GLELE KAKAÏ - LABEF |url=https://labef-uac.org/fr/team/romain-lucas-glele-kakai/ |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |language=fr-FR |last=JournalSanteEnvironnement |title=L'IA dans la santé, l'agriculture et l'environnement: le LABEF/UAC mobilise les chercheurs africains |url=https://journalsantenvironnement.com/lia-dans-la-sante-lagriculture-et-lenvironnement-le-labef-uac-mobilise-les-chercheurs-africains/ |website=JOURNAL SANTE ENVIRONNEMENT |date=2024-11-16 |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=ORCID |url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6965-4331 |website=orcid.org |access-date=2025-06-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |language=fr-FR |last=JournalSanteEnvironnement |title=Le LABEF/UAC outille docteurs, doctorants et mastorants |url=https://journalsantenvironnement.com/le-labef-uac-outille-docteurs-doctorants-et-mastorants/ |website=JOURNAL SANTE ENVIRONNEMENT |date=2024-11-16 |access-date=2025-06-28}}</ref>

== Contributions ==

Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï is an FAO expert in training and designing National Forest Inventory methodologies for West African countries. He is Director of the Humboldt Hub on socio-ecological modeling of COVID-19 in Africa.<ref>{{Cite web |language=en |title=GLELE KAKAÏ |url=https://hrh.semca-uac.org/en/members/glele-kakai |website=Hrh-Semca |access-date=2025-06-30}}</ref>

In 2023, he developed an age-structured mathematical model<ref>{{cite journal |first1=Barikissou Georgia|last1=Damien|first2=Akoeugnigan Idelphonse|last2=Sode|first3=Daniel|last3=Bocossa|first4=Emmanuel|last4=Elanga-Ndille|title=Bayesian spatial modelling of malaria burden in two contrasted eco-epidemiological facies in Benin (West Africa): call for localized interventions|journal=BMC Public Health|volume=22|number=1|pages=1754|date=2022-09-16|issn=1471-2458|pmid=36114483|pmc=9479262|doi=10.1186/s12889-022-14032-9|doi-access=free }}</ref> and associated computer code capable of analyzing the impact of different vaccination scenarios on the malaria burden in African countries.<ref>{{Cite web |title=People Directory |url=https://www.vaccineimpact.org/people-directory |access-date=2025-06-30 |website=Vaccine Impact |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Ir. Romain Lucas GLELE KAKAÏ - LABEF |url=https://labef-uac.org/fr/team/romain-lucas-glele-kakai/ |access-date=2025-06-30 |language=fr-FR}}</ref>

He is one of the group leaders on malaria modeling within the Vaccine Impact Modelling Consortium (VIMC), a task force that provides the GAVI and the World Health Organization with projections on the impact of vaccination on the burden of infectious diseases worldwide.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Google Scholar |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FwpDoXMAAAAJ&hl=fr |access-date=2025-06-30 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Romain Lucas GLELE KAKAÏ {{!}} Professor (Full) {{!}} Biomathematics and Forest modeling {{!}} University of Abomey-Calavi, Cotonou {{!}} UAC {{!}} Laboratoire de Biomathématiques et d'Estimations Forestières {{!}} Research profile |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Romain-Lucas-Glele-Kakai |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230506133359/https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Romain-Lucas-Glele-Kakai |archive-date=2023-05-06 |access-date=2025-06-30 |website=ResearchGate |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sciences (TWAS) |first=The World Academy of |title=Benin {{!}} TWAS |url=https://twas.org/taxonomy/term/49 |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=twas.org |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Romain Lucas Glèlè Kakaï : Livres, Biographie, Livres Audio, Bibliographie... - La Boutique Africavivre |url=https://www.laboutiqueafricavivre.com/s/26228/romain-lucas-glele-kakai |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=Africa Vivre |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Romain Glèlè Kakaï |url=https://popups.uliege.be/1780-4507/index.php/index.php?type=auteur&id=14499&lang=en |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=popups.uliege.be |language=fr}}</ref>
